inspection_notice.name: Inspection
inspection_notice.text: Over the radio: "An inspection arrives in two days. We'll check the stockpile. Smile - the cameras are rolling."

escape_rumors.name: Escape Rumors
escape_rumors.text: Rumors crawl through the barracks that there is a way off the planet. The guards smirk suspiciously.

smuggler_signal.name: Smuggler Signal
smuggler_signal.text: At night, a voice on the guard frequency: "Got anything cleaner? I pay double. Keep it quiet."

new_prisoners.name: Debt Transfer
new_prisoners.text: A barge dropped a transfer: {target}. Each comes with a bill for delivery.

metropolis_decree.name: Metropole Decree
metropolis_decree.text: The Metropole decree was read out between lunch and roll call.

letter_home.name: Letter from Home
letter_home.text: {target} received a letter from home. The censor struck out nearly everything except "we wait" and "don't write".
